title: 🪙 AI agents pay for themselves! 213,000 paid requests on the XRP network!
body: 🪙 AI agents pay for themselves! 213,000 paid requests on the XRP network!

Independent AI agents have paid for more than 213,000 requests on the XRP Ledger in a new payment experiment, in a step that shows how agents can buy the services they need by themselves, without human intervention in every payment.

Payments company T54 Labs ran the experiment in a closed beta between October 14 and 17, settling 213,008 paid requests across 3,162 sessions using 6,324 transactions on the network, with an average fee of 0.36 of an XRP per paid request — a tiny amount.

And on November 18, two checks were cashed on the network paying the same amount to the same AI service, the Heurist inference-routing service, in the dollar-pegged stablecoin RLUSD, proving the system also works with real payments outside the experiment.

The network is expanding fast: agents can now access more than 5,400 digital services and deal with more than 190 merchants to buy computing power and data services, paying in XRP or the stablecoin RLUSD, in what is known as the machine economy.

The idea, simply, is that a smart agent that needs a service, such as data processing or text analysis, pays for it instantly by itself from its digital wallet, instead of waiting for a human credit card — and this could become the usual way of paying for agents' work.
Simply put: an AI that buys and pays on its own... will agents soon have their own wallets?
Can you imagine a day when your smart assistant pays its own subscriptions without you asking?
